tools.name: connect_ssh
tools.description: Establishes a persistent, stateful connection to a remote SSH server, automatically accepting host keys.

host.description: The hostname or IP address of the SSH server to connect to.

port.description: The port number of the SSH server (default is 22).

key_filepath.description: Optional absolute path to a private key file (SSH key) for authentication.

banner_timeout.description: The timeout in seconds to wait for the MOTD/welcome banner (default is 2.0).

tools.name: create_local
tools.description: Creates a persistent local terminal session (PTY on supported platforms).

shell.description: Optional absolute path or executable name of the shell to use (e.g., 'powershell.exe', '/bin/bash').

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Execute a command in a session (SSH or local).

session_id.description: The unique session identifier returned by connect_ssh or create_local.

pause_timeout.description: Seconds of output silence to wait before returning a partial response (default is 9.0).

total_timeout.description: Hard cap in seconds on the maximum duration of this call (default is 20.0).

tools.name: respond
tools.description: Send text input to a command that returned status='partial' and is waiting at a prompt.

command_id.description: The active command_id returned in a partial status response.

text.description: The text input to send to the command.

pause_timeout.description: Seconds of output silence to wait before returning (default is 9.0).

total_timeout.description: Hard cap in seconds on the maximum duration of this call (default is 20.0).

tools.name: read_output
tools.description: Read new output from a running command without sending any input.

command_id.description: The active command_id returned in a partial status response.

pause_timeout.description: Seconds of output silence to wait before returning (default is 9.0).

total_timeout.description: Hard cap in seconds on the maximum duration of this call (default is 20.0).

tools.name: send_control
tools.description: Send a control key/signal to a running command.

command_id.description: The active command_id returned in a partial status response.

signal.description: The control signal or key to send (e.g. 'ctrl+c', 'ctrl+z', arrow keys).

pause_timeout.description: Seconds of output silence to wait before returning (default is 9.0).

total_timeout.description: Hard cap in seconds on the maximum duration of this call (default is 20.0).

tools.name: disconnect
tools.description: Gracefully disconnects from an active terminal session (SSH or local) and cleans up all associated resources.

session_id.description: The unique session identifier returned by connect_ssh or create_local.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List all currently active terminal sessions (SSH and local) managed by this server.
